clips.title: The story
paras: The Stonewrought Dam faces a suspected Dark Iron plot, and Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII needs rare reagents from Loch Modan. You gather them so he can make a mixture to defuse explosives beneath the dam.

Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII needs a strange mixture to stop Dark Iron explosives. It takes Forest Lurker venom, a tear from a crocolisk in the Loch, and a Mo'grosh crystal. Together, these reagents can render the dwarven charges inert.

You search Loch Modan's dangerous reaches for the ingredients. Forest Lurker spiders and crocolisks pose natural hazards, while Mo'grosh crystals lie in the ogres' stronghold in the northeastern hills. The ogres guard their mined crystals jealously, so reaching one means facing their encampments.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Begin collecting the disarming materials immediately, friend. Lurker Venom can be found on the indigenous spiders in Loch Modan. Crocolisk tears are found here in the Loch as well. But a Mo'Grosh crystal will be very difficult to procure. The ogres to the northeast mine them but the crystals are a very rare commodity.
We need to be prepared to defuse a Dark Iron attack! Return to me once you've collected the needed items and I will prepare the mixture.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the needed items? Time is of the essence!!
